blocks.source: Canto XXXI
blocks.translation: Canto XXXI

blocks.source: Una medesma lingua pria mi morse,
blocks.translation: One and the selfsame tongue first wounded me,

blocks.source: sì che mi tinse l’una e l’altra guancia,
blocks.translation: So that it tinged the one cheek and the other,

blocks.source: e poi la medicina mi riporse;
blocks.translation: And then held out to me the medicine;

blocks.source: così od’ io che solea far la lancia
blocks.translation: Thus do I hear that once Achilles’ spear,

blocks.source: d’Achille e del suo padre esser cagione
blocks.translation: His and his father’s, used to be the cause

blocks.source: prima di trista e poi di buona mancia.
blocks.translation: First of a sad and then a gracious boon.

blocks.source: Noi demmo il dosso al misero vallone
blocks.translation: We turned our backs upon the wretched valley,

blocks.source: su per la ripa che ’l cinge dintorno,
blocks.translation: Upon the bank that girds it round about,

blocks.source: attraversando sanza alcun sermone.
blocks.translation: Going across it without any speech.

blocks.source: Quiv’ era men che notte e men che giorno,
blocks.translation: There it was less than night, and less than day,

blocks.source: sì che ’l viso m’andava innanzi poco;
blocks.translation: So that my sight went little in advance;

blocks.source: ma io senti’ sonare un alto corno,
blocks.translation: But I could hear the blare of a loud horn,

blocks.source: tanto ch’avrebbe ogne tuon fatto fioco,
blocks.translation: So loud it would have made each thunder faint,

blocks.source: che, contra sé la sua via seguitando,
blocks.translation: Which, counter to it following its way,

blocks.source: dirizzò li occhi miei tutti ad un loco.
blocks.translation: Mine eyes directed wholly to one place.

blocks.source: Dopo la dolorosa rotta, quando
blocks.translation: After the dolorous discomfiture

blocks.source: Carlo Magno perdé la santa gesta,
blocks.translation: When Charlemagne the holy emprise lost,

blocks.source: non sonò sì terribilmente Orlando.
blocks.translation: So terribly Orlando sounded not.

blocks.source: Poco portäi in là volta la testa,
blocks.translation: Short while my head turned thitherward I held

blocks.source: che me parve veder molte alte torri;
blocks.translation: When many lofty towers I seemed to see,

blocks.source: ond’ io: «Maestro, dì, che terra è questa?».
blocks.translation: Whereat I: “Master, say, what town is this?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Però che tu trascorri
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Because thou peerest forth

blocks.source: per le tenebre troppo da la lungi,
blocks.translation: Athwart the darkness at too great a distance,

blocks.source: avvien che poi nel maginare abborri.
blocks.translation: It happens that thou errest in thy fancy.

blocks.source: Tu vedrai ben, se tu là ti congiungi,
blocks.translation: Well shalt thou see, if thou arrivest there,

blocks.source: quanto ’l senso s’inganna di lontano;
blocks.translation: How much the sense deceives itself by distance;

blocks.source: però alquanto più te stesso pungi».
blocks.translation: Therefore a little faster spur thee on.”

blocks.source: Poi caramente mi prese per mano
blocks.translation: Then tenderly he took me by the hand,

blocks.source: e disse: «Pria che noi siam più avanti,
blocks.translation: And said: “Before we farther have advanced,

blocks.source: acciò che ’l fatto men ti paia strano,
blocks.translation: That the reality may seem to thee

blocks.source: sappi che non son torri, ma giganti,
blocks.translation: Less strange, know that these are not towers, but giants,

blocks.source: e son nel pozzo intorno da la ripa
blocks.translation: And they are in the well, around the bank,

blocks.source: da l’umbilico in giuso tutti quanti».
blocks.translation: From navel downward, one and all of them.”

blocks.source: Come quando la nebbia si dissipa,
blocks.translation: As, when the fog is vanishing away,

blocks.source: lo sguardo a poco a poco raffigura
blocks.translation: Little by little doth the sight refigure

blocks.source: ciò che cela ’l vapor che l’aere stipa,
blocks.translation: Whate’er the mist that crowds the air conceals,

blocks.source: così forando l’aura grossa e scura,
blocks.translation: So, piercing through the dense and darksome air,

blocks.source: più e più appressando ver’ la sponda,
blocks.translation: More and more near approaching tow’rd the verge,

blocks.source: fuggiemi errore e cresciemi paura;
blocks.translation: My error fled, and fear came over me;

blocks.source: però che, come su la cerchia tonda
blocks.translation: Because as on its circular parapets

blocks.source: Montereggion di torri si corona,
blocks.translation: Montereggione crowns itself with towers,

blocks.source: così la proda che ’l pozzo circonda
blocks.translation: E’en thus the margin which surrounds the well

blocks.source: torreggiavan di mezza la persona
blocks.translation: With one half of their bodies turreted

blocks.source: li orribili giganti, cui minaccia
blocks.translation: The horrible giants, whom Jove menaces

blocks.source: Giove del cielo ancora quando tuona.
blocks.translation: E’en now from out the heavens when he thunders.

blocks.source: E io scorgeva già d’alcun la faccia,
blocks.translation: And I of one already saw the face,

blocks.source: le spalle e ’l petto e del ventre gran parte,
blocks.translation: Shoulders, and breast, and great part of the belly,

blocks.source: e per le coste giù ambo le braccia.
blocks.translation: And down along his sides both of the arms.

blocks.source: Natura certo, quando lasciò l’arte
blocks.translation: Certainly Nature, when she left the making

blocks.source: di sì fatti animali, assai fé bene
blocks.translation: Of animals like these, did well indeed,

blocks.source: per tòrre tali essecutori a Marte.
blocks.translation: By taking such executors from Mars;

blocks.source: E s’ella d’elefanti e di balene
blocks.translation: And if of elephants and whales she doth not

blocks.source: non si pente, chi guarda sottilmente,
blocks.translation: Repent her, whosoever looketh subtly

blocks.source: più giusta e più discreta la ne tene;
blocks.translation: More just and more discreet will hold her for it;

blocks.source: ché dove l’argomento de la mente
blocks.translation: For where the argument of intellect

blocks.source: s’aggiugne al mal volere e a la possa,
blocks.translation: Is added unto evil will and power,

blocks.source: nessun riparo vi può far la gente.
blocks.translation: No rampart can the people make against it.

blocks.source: La faccia sua mi parea lunga e grossa
blocks.translation: His face appeared to me as long and large

blocks.source: come la pina di San Pietro a Roma,
blocks.translation: As is at Rome the pine-cone of Saint Peter’s,

blocks.source: e a sua proporzione eran l’altre ossa;
blocks.translation: And in proportion were the other bones;

blocks.source: sì che la ripa, ch’era perizoma
blocks.translation: So that the margin, which an apron was

blocks.source: dal mezzo in giù, ne mostrava ben tanto
blocks.translation: Down from the middle, showed so much of him

blocks.source: di sovra, che di giugnere a la chioma
blocks.translation: Above it, that to reach up to his hair

blocks.source: tre Frison s’averien dato mal vanto;
blocks.translation: Three Frieslanders in vain had vaunted them;

blocks.source: però ch’i’ ne vedea trenta gran palmi
blocks.translation: For I beheld thirty great palms of him

blocks.source: dal loco in giù dov’ omo affibbia ’l manto.
blocks.translation: Down from the place where man his mantle buckles.

blocks.source: «Raphèl maì amècche zabì almi»,
blocks.translation: “Raphael mai amech izabi almi,”

blocks.source: cominciò a gridar la fiera bocca,
blocks.translation: Began to clamour the ferocious mouth,

blocks.source: cui non si convenia più dolci salmi.
blocks.translation: To which were not befitting sweeter psalms.

blocks.source: E ’l duca mio ver’ lui: «Anima sciocca,
blocks.translation: And unto him my Guide: “Soul idiotic,

blocks.source: tienti col corno, e con quel ti disfoga
blocks.translation: Keep to thy horn, and vent thyself with that,

blocks.source: quand’ ira o altra passïon ti tocca!
blocks.translation: When wrath or other passion touches thee.

blocks.source: Cércati al collo, e troverai la soga
blocks.translation: Search round thy neck, and thou wilt find the belt

blocks.source: che ’l tien legato, o anima confusa,
blocks.translation: Which keeps it fastened, O bewildered soul,

blocks.source: e vedi lui che ’l gran petto ti doga».
blocks.translation: And see it, where it bars thy mighty breast.”

blocks.source: Poi disse a me: «Elli stessi s’accusa;
blocks.translation: Then said to me: “He doth himself accuse;

blocks.source: questi è Nembrotto per lo cui mal coto
blocks.translation: This one is Nimrod, by whose evil thought

blocks.source: pur un linguaggio nel mondo non s’usa.
blocks.translation: One language in the world is not still used.

blocks.source: Lasciànlo stare e non parliamo a vòto;
blocks.translation: Here let us leave him and not speak in vain;

blocks.source: ché così è a lui ciascun linguaggio
blocks.translation: For even such to him is every language

blocks.source: come ’l suo ad altrui, ch’a nullo è noto».
blocks.translation: As his to others, which to none is known.”

blocks.source: Facemmo adunque più lungo vïaggio,
blocks.translation: Therefore a longer journey did we make,

blocks.source: vòlti a sinistra; e al trar d’un balestro
blocks.translation: Turned to the left, and a crossbow-shot oft

blocks.source: trovammo l’altro assai più fero e maggio.
blocks.translation: We found another far more fierce and large.

blocks.source: A cigner lui qual che fosse ’l maestro,
blocks.translation: In binding him, who might the master be

blocks.source: non so io dir, ma el tenea soccinto
blocks.translation: I cannot say; but he had pinioned close

blocks.source: dinanzi l’altro e dietro il braccio destro
blocks.translation: Behind the right arm, and in front the other,

blocks.source: d’una catena che ’l tenea avvinto
blocks.translation: With chains, that held him so begirt about

blocks.source: dal collo in giù, sì che ’n su lo scoperto
blocks.translation: From the neck down, that on the part uncovered

blocks.source: si ravvolgëa infino al giro quinto.
blocks.translation: It wound itself as far as the fifth gyre.

blocks.source: «Questo superbo volle esser esperto
blocks.translation: “This proud one wished to make experiment

blocks.source: di sua potenza contra ’l sommo Giove»,
blocks.translation: Of his own power against the Supreme Jove,”

blocks.source: disse ’l mio duca, «ond’ elli ha cotal merto.
blocks.translation: My Leader said, “whence he has such a guerdon.

blocks.source: Fïalte ha nome, e fece le gran prove
blocks.translation: Ephialtes is his name; he showed great prowess.

blocks.source: quando i giganti fer paura a’ dèi;
blocks.translation: What time the giants terrified the gods;

blocks.source: le braccia ch’el menò, già mai non move».
blocks.translation: The arms he wielded never more he moves.”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «S’esser puote, io vorrei
blocks.translation: And I to him: “If possible, I should wish

blocks.source: che de lo smisurato Brïareo
blocks.translation: That of the measureless Briareus

blocks.source: esperïenza avesser li occhi mei».
blocks.translation: These eyes of mine might have experience.”

blocks.source: Ond’ ei rispuose: «Tu vedrai Anteo
blocks.translation: Whence he replied: “Thou shalt behold Antaeus

blocks.source: presso di qui che parla ed è disciolto,
blocks.translation: Close by here, who can speak and is unbound,

blocks.source: che ne porrà nel fondo d’ogne reo.
blocks.translation: Who at the bottom of all crime shall place us.

blocks.source: Quel che tu vuo’ veder, più là è molto
blocks.translation: Much farther yon is he whom thou wouldst see,

blocks.source: ed è legato e fatto come questo,
blocks.translation: And he is bound, and fashioned like to this one,

blocks.source: salvo che più feroce par nel volto».
blocks.translation: Save that he seems in aspect more ferocious.”

blocks.source: Non fu tremoto già tanto rubesto,
blocks.translation: There never was an earthquake of such might

blocks.source: che scotesse una torre così forte,
blocks.translation: That it could shake a tower so violently,

blocks.source: come Fïalte a scuotersi fu presto.
blocks.translation: As Ephialtes suddenly shook himself.

blocks.source: Allor temett’ io più che mai la morte,
blocks.translation: Then was I more afraid of death than ever,

blocks.source: e non v’era mestier più che la dotta,
blocks.translation: For nothing more was needful than the fear,

blocks.source: s’io non avessi viste le ritorte.
blocks.translation: If I had not beheld the manacles.

blocks.source: Noi procedemmo più avante allotta,
blocks.translation: Then we proceeded farther in advance,

blocks.source: e venimmo ad Anteo, che ben cinque alle,
blocks.translation: And to Antaeus came, who, full five ells

blocks.source: sanza la testa, uscia fuor de la grotta.
blocks.translation: Without the head, forth issued from the cavern.

blocks.source: «O tu che ne la fortunata valle
blocks.translation: “O thou, who in the valley fortunate,

blocks.source: che fece Scipïon di gloria reda,
blocks.translation: Which Scipio the heir of glory made,

blocks.source: quand’ Anibàl co’ suoi diede le spalle,
blocks.translation: When Hannibal turned back with all his hosts,

blocks.source: recasti già mille leon per preda,
blocks.translation: Once brought’st a thousand lions for thy prey,

blocks.source: e che, se fossi stato a l’alta guerra
blocks.translation: And who, hadst thou been at the mighty war

blocks.source: de’ tuoi fratelli, ancor par che si creda
blocks.translation: Among thy brothers, some it seems still think

blocks.source: ch’avrebber vinto i figli de la terra:
blocks.translation: The sons of Earth the victory would have gained:

blocks.source: mettine giù, e non ten vegna schifo,
blocks.translation: Place us below, nor be disdainful of it,

blocks.source: dove Cocito la freddura serra.
blocks.translation: There where the cold doth lock Cocytus up.

blocks.source: Non ci fare ire a Tizio né a Tifo:
blocks.translation: Make us not go to Tityus nor Typhoeus;

blocks.source: questi può dar di quel che qui si brama;
blocks.translation: This one can give of that which here is longed for;

blocks.source: però ti china e non torcer lo grifo.
blocks.translation: Therefore stoop down, and do not curl thy lip.

blocks.source: Ancor ti può nel mondo render fama,
blocks.translation: Still in the world can he restore thy fame;

blocks.source: ch’el vive, e lunga vita ancor aspetta
blocks.translation: Because he lives, and still expects long life,

blocks.source: se ’nnanzi tempo grazia a sé nol chiama».
blocks.translation: If to itself Grace call him not untimely.”

blocks.source: Così disse ’l maestro; e quelli in fretta
blocks.translation: So said the Master; and in haste the other

blocks.source: le man distese, e prese ’l duca mio,
blocks.translation: His hands extended and took up my Guide,—

blocks.source: ond’ Ercule sentì già grande stretta.
blocks.translation: Hands whose great pressure Hercules once felt.

blocks.source: Virgilio, quando prender si sentio,
blocks.translation: Virgilius, when he felt himself embraced,

blocks.source: disse a me: «Fatti qua, sì ch’io ti prenda»;
blocks.translation: Said unto me: “Draw nigh, that I may take thee;”

blocks.source: poi fece sì ch’un fascio era elli e io.
blocks.translation: Then of himself and me one bundle made.

blocks.source: Qual pare a riguardar la Carisenda
blocks.translation: As seems the Carisenda, to behold

blocks.source: sotto ’l chinato, quando un nuvol vada
blocks.translation: Beneath the leaning side, when goes a cloud

blocks.source: sovr’ essa sì, ched ella incontro penda:
blocks.translation: Above it so that opposite it hangs;

blocks.source: tal parve Antëo a me che stava a bada
blocks.translation: Such did Antaeus seem to me, who stood

blocks.source: di vederlo chinare, e fu tal ora
blocks.translation: Watching to see him stoop, and then it was

blocks.source: ch’i’ avrei voluto ir per altra strada.
blocks.translation: I could have wished to go some other way.

blocks.source: Ma lievemente al fondo che divora
blocks.translation: But lightly in the abyss, which swallows up

blocks.source: Lucifero con Giuda, ci sposò;
blocks.translation: Judas with Lucifer, he put us down;

blocks.source: né, sì chinato, lì fece dimora,
blocks.translation: Nor thus bowed downward made he there delay,

blocks.source: e come albero in nave si levò.
blocks.translation: But, as a mast does in a ship, uprose.
